rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when representing something mainly in words or speech.

example.english: This interview uses simple words to depict life in the fishing village.
example.traditional: 呢段訪問用好簡單嘅說話描述咗個漁村嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 fong2 man6 jung6 hou2 gaan2 daan1 ge3 syut3 waa6 miu4 seot6 zo2 go3 jyu4 cyun1 ge3 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this when the representation is visual and is literally drawn or shown in an image.

example.english: This mural is meant to depict the lively New Year celebration among the neighbours.
example.traditional: 呢幅壁畫畫出咗街坊一齊過年嘅熱鬧場面。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 bik1 waa2 waak6 ceot1 zo2 gaai1 fong1 jat1 cai4 gwo3 nin4 ge3 jit6 naau6 coeng4 min2

rows.note: Use this for a more polished or vivid portrayal, especially in writing or formal description.

example.english: The novel uses delicate prose to depict the character of old Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢部小說以細膩筆觸描繪舊香港嘅風貌。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 siu2 syut3 ji5 sai3 nei6 bat1 zuk1 miu4 kui2 gau6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 fung1 maau6
